rationale: The combinational gate allows mode to rise after a ref_clk rising edge, creating a late clk_sel edge, or fall during its high phase, truncating the pulse. The 0.1 to 1.5 input delay permits these transitions; neither a low-phase enable latch nor a static-mode contract is present. This is an unsafe clock enable, classified by the clock-control row rather than merely an inventory omission.

labels.rationale: mode is allowed to change after a ref_clk rising edge by its input timing contract. Combinational gating can therefore create a late rising edge or truncate a high pulse. No low-phase latch, glitch-free gate or static mode constraint is supplied.

mode gates ref_clk combinationally. A permitted mode transition while ref_clk is high creates a rising clk_sel edge unrelated to a ref_clk edge; neither a low-phase enable latch nor a static-mode contract is present. Root declaration alone cannot justify this derived clock.
